criteria.summary: provenance.voice names director:identity.verbal.voice: Writer copy derives from the pinned voice, which is provenance, never an input.
The source is derived and every ref is director:<slot>, writer:<slot> or a finding: no bare id, other agent or URL.
One ## <locale> per frontmatter locale; each ### key has a meta comment whose id is the key, a value, and appears once.
Plain values are finished: no placeholder, markup, doubled spaces, and valid ICU when params.icu.
Every plain value is within its params.limits row (by key suffix) or the default maxChars and maxWords.
Heading-like values are sentence case (params.proper names excepted) and never end in !.
Every entry is one json record of a params.kinds kind, id and context the key, with that kind's fields.
Every claim cites a director: strategy, requires a citation and has no unprovable superlative.
Every narrative is one json record in a frames.* frame, told as <slot>#<key> references or typed text blocks.
Every key ends in one of params.parts, and each group holds each required part exactly once.
